$comment: F-49 contract overlay (mock only). field_extra holds the PROPOSED optional keys the mock adds to an E-LINES intake field beyond the generated type: show_when (G-23-2: the field is drawn only while another field holds one of the listed values) and allow_new (G-23-1: a client field that accepts {new: {name}}; served only with the cookie psl_mock_rfp=new_client). start_extra holds the PROPOSED intake values of E-WORK-START: client as an option value or {new: {name}}, and deadline_status (G-23-3) as unknown, stated or not_stated. The backend developer may change or refuse any of them.
